author: Mark Atwood
text:
Escalating: the bead's premise 'this is currently the only such type' is incorrect. pkix-aia/src/lib.rs already independently defines AiaError::IoFailure { kind: std::io::ErrorKind, message: String } as a variant — the same shape pkix-truststore uses for its IoFailure struct. Memory pkix-serde-wire-form-2026-05-13 documents this as PKIX-2l0v.1 D3: 'io::Error in error types gets replaced by IoFailure { kind: io::ErrorKind, message: String } at the boundary, since io::Error is not Clone+Eq+Serialize. Apply this convention to any new result type.'

So the workspace already chose per-crate-pattern (shape convention) over single-type-reuse. The bead's recommended option (c) would reverse that decision. Three possible paths:

(c1) Lift IoFailure into pkix-path (parallel to DerError). pkix-truststore + pkix-aia + future adapters re-export it. Breaking change: AiaError::IoFailure variant payload becomes pkix_path::IoFailure rather than an inline { kind, message } pair (cosmetically the same wire form but a typed variant differs from anonymous fields).

(c2) New pkix-shared (or pkix-core) crate hosting IoFailure + DerError. Bigger refactor; benefits when more shared types appear.

(c-stay) Keep the convention as-is — per-crate IoFailure replicating the shape. Documented decision PKIX-2l0v.1 D3.

Decision wants human input because: (a) reversing PKIX-2l0v.1 D3 is a workspace-stance change, (b) AiaError variant shape change is a pre-1.0 breaking but visible-to-tests change, (c) the choice of pkix-path vs new pkix-shared isn't covered by the existing precedent (DerError lives in pkix-path because it wraps der::Error from a pkix-path dep — IoFailure doesn't wrap a pkix-path concern).

Recommendation if no human pushback within 24h: take option (c-stay). The PKIX-2l0v.1 D3 convention is already established and pkix-aia already follows it without issue; adding option (c) now would be a workspace-wide refactor with no concrete pain-point demand beyond architectural cleanness. Pre-1.0 framing argues for design closure, but PKIX-2l0v.1 D3 IS the design closure — it explicitly chose the shape-convention path. Reopening that without new evidence is making a different choice, not completing one.
